formulas.name: Economic baseline
formulas.rationale: Equal weights provide a transparent economic-only comparator; salary has no effect.

formulas.name: Additive salary exposure
formulas.rationale: Treat income exposure as a separate equally weighted component. This is a hypothesis, not a validated weighting.

formulas.name: Salary interaction
formulas.rationale: Test whether salary moderates economic pressure. It becomes zero when normalized economic pressure is zero, a limitation to evaluate.

metadata.salary_exposure: V = reference salary / (reference salary + employee salary)
metadata.validation_status: Exploratory prototype; no empirical accuracy established
limitations: Pilot reference ranges are not clinical or population thresholds.
CPI and inflation may overlap; indicator ablation is still required.
Positive unemployment direction is an assumed insecurity channel, not a turnover claim.
Salary is not disposable household income; debt, dependents and expenses are absent.
No formula has been selected as the final EESI.

data_note: 100 synthetic HR records; supplied economic pilot values have not been independently verified.
